credits: Original geometry drawn for Verdant Reach under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md). Botanical reference: Atropa belladonna, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Atropa_belladonna . No sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. Atropa belladonna. LOOMING: a bushy plant on a short thick stem whose arching branches and soft pointed leaves overhang the foe; dull purple bells, tinged green at the base, hang beneath the leaves, and shiny black berries, each set in a green star-shaped calyx, hang in two clusters of three or more (never a level pair). Gesture: the bells sway and the front berry cluster swings, hold, rebound and settle; stems and leaves stay fixed. A deep green dark slot (leaves, stems, calyces, the bells' green base) under a dull violet mid tone (the bells and the bud); the berries are the outline black with white glints. Sport: Atropa belladonna var. lutea, the rare natural form with pale-yellow flowers and fruit (the black berries cannot change in a sport, so only the flowers turn pale yellow).
